_comment: Camera effects (flight_core::camera::CameraTuning). Assumed values. fov_curve: speed m/s -> vertical FOV deg. streak_curve: speed m/s -> streak level 0..1. Look-ahead: the view leads a turn by gain x turn rate, past the dead zone (rad/s), capped, eased. Bump: touchdown drop per m/s of approach speed, damped; a touchdown is a loss of more than bump_threshold m/s towards the ground in one step near the ground.
